Lesson Title: Career Cluster Exploration Day 1

TEKS Student Expectation(s): §127.2. Career and College Exploration. (B) explore and describe the CTE career clusters.

Learning objective: Today you will identify three career clusters and state one job in each. Students will compare pathways using a graphic organizer.

Anticipatory set / Do Now / Engage: Warm-up — list jobs you know in your community.

Direct instruction / teach / explain content vocabulary: Mini-lesson on the 14 CTE career clusters and key vocabulary.

Modeling / I do / demonstrate: Teacher thinks aloud while sorting sample jobs into clusters on the board.

Check for understanding / CFU: Thumbs up if you can name your cluster; cold call two students.

Guided practice / We do / together: With support, pairs place five job cards into the correct cluster.

Independent practice / You do / on your own: Complete the pathway organizer independently for homework.

Closure / exit ticket / wrap up: Summarize one cluster and one related job on an exit ticket.

Formative assessment checkpoint: exit ticket responses inform tomorrow's grouping.
